description:
# 🐛 Bug-fix PR

---

## 📌 Summary
Use autocomplete="new-password" on the user creation field so browsers offer strong password generation, add autocomplete="off" to the commented-out A2A agent auth field, and add unit + Playwright tests to prevent autocomplete regressions across all templates.

Closes #2626

## 🔁 Reproduction Steps
1. Log into the Admin UI (browser saves email/password)
2. Navigate to MCP Servers tab or any section with API key fields
3. Click on an API key input field
4. Observe browser NOT offering to autofill with saved login credentials

## 🐞 Root Cause
The `autocomplete` attribute was set to off for the new password field on the new user form, and was not set on the A2A Agent auth field.


## 🧪 Verification

| Check                                 | Command              | Status |
|---------------------------------------|----------------------|--------|
| Lint suite                            | `make lint`          |    ✅    |
| Unit tests                            | `make test`          |    ✅    |
| Coverage ≥ 80 %                       | `make coverage`      |    ✅    |
| Manual regression no longer fails     | steps / screenshots  |    ✅    |


## ✅ Checklist
- [X] Code formatted (`make black isort pre-commit`)
- [X] No secrets/credentials committed

reviews.author: crivetimihai
reviews.body:
LGTM — clean, minimal change with solid regression coverage.

**Template changes reviewed:**
- `autocomplete="new-password"` on user creation password field correctly enables browser password generators per the HTML spec.
- `autocomplete="off"` on the commented-out A2A agent auth field future-proofs it for when it's enabled.
- Both changes are consistent with the existing codebase pattern: `current-password` for login, `new-password` for creation/change flows, `off` for all API keys/tokens/secrets (29 fields).

**Tests reviewed:**
- Unit tests parse all templates with `HTMLParser`, validating every password field has the correct `autocomplete` value — good regression guard.
- Playwright E2E tests cover login, gateways (basic/bearer/OAuth), user creation, LLM provider key, and MCP registry key fields.

**Cleanup applied during rebase:**
- Removed unused `import re` and `BASE_URL` import in Playwright test (ruff F401).
- Removed dead `_in_comment` field and unreachable `handle_comment` method in unit test parser.

No security or performance concerns.
